15.
(1)  The Board shall have the power to enter into any
agreement  with  any  person  or  partnership  including  joint
ventures,  for  the  purpose  of  exercising,  performing  and
discharging the powers, duties and functions of the Authority.
(2)  Every  such  agreement  shall  be  in  writing  and  shall
upon registration with the Authority, constitute a valid and
binding contract between the Authority and such Government
Department, Local  Authority or other body.
